keywords.def: a nasal sound held for two counts

questions.q: Read 69:7 to 8 and name every meem sakinah rule and ghunnah.
questions.a: سَخَّرَهَا عَلَيْهِمْ سَبْعَ izhar shafawi; كَأَنَّهُمْ أَعْجَازُ izhar shafawi and ghunnah on نّ; لَهُم مِّنۢ idgham shafawi.

questions.q: Meem audit (pupil PDF): classify each meem sakinah in 69:18 to 30. Today's rota group recites Al-Qalam 68:1 to 16.
questions.a: مِنكُمْ خَافِيَةٌۭ (69:18), لَمْ أُوتَ (69:25), وَلَمْ أَدْرِ (69:26): all izhar shafawi. (هَآؤُمُ in 69:19 has a vowel, so no rule.)

questions.q: Extend: find one idgham shafawi in Al-Mulk or Al-Qalam.
Stretch: explain why ikhfa shafawi has ghunnah but izhar shafawi does not.
questions.a: Before ب the meem is hidden, so its natural ghunnah shows; before other letters it is said clearly and complete.
A) Idgham shafawi. Meem sakinah before meem merges with ghunnah: idgham shafawi (mithlayn saghir).

questions.q: Think again: Your lips make both م and ب. What do you think happens when a meem sakinah meets a baa?
questions.a: The meem is hidden with a two-count hum, lips lightly together: ikhfa shafawi.
